title: The CEO Who Sold 'AI Therapy'—It Was a Chatbot Trained on Prison Letters
hook: A wellness startup's chatbot was secretly learning from inmates' most desperate confessions—and billing it as premium mental health care.

why_this_can_go_viral: Wearable tech privacy fear is a hot topic—viewers will imagine their own data being stolen.
